en-US.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
en-US.description: The Scheduler Extension for LabChart allows the scheduling of recordings across one or more LabChart data files.
en-US.longDescription: The Scheduler Extension for LabChart allows the scheduling of recordings across one or more LabChart data files. A schedule may consist of an initial delay, followed by repeated recording cycles, until a specified end time. Scheduler can also be used with external scheduling devices, such as the TR Scheduler Pod.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Scheduler

zh-CN.description: LabChart Scheduler 扩展支持在一个或多个数据文件中规划录制任务。
zh-CN.longDescription: LabChart Scheduler 扩展支持在一个或多个数据文件中规划录制任务。调度方案可包含初始延迟设置，随后按周期循环录制，直至达到指定结束时间。该调度器还可与外部定时设备（如 TR 调度器模块）配合使用。
